simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲשַׂרְאֵל (H840) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word is connected to the original Hebrew source text, so BibleIQ can explain it from the underlying word rather than only the English translation.
simple.summary: אֲשַׂרְאֵל (ʼĂsarʼêl) means Asarel , an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Chr 4 16.

definitions.full: H840. Asarel אֲשַׂרְאֵל proper name, masculine a descendant of Judah 1Chr 4:16 (the latter element in this & following may be אֵל God , but meaning of former part dubious Thes compare אסר bind, quem Deus obligavit sc. voto ).
definitions.rootNote: by orthographical variation from 833 and 410 ; right of God;
